title: Final Project
text:
figure. 3. Concentrations in Bisley, Puerto Rico streams before and after Hurricane Hugo, 9-wk moving averages. (a) potassium, (b) nitrate-N, (c) magnesium, (d) calcium and (e) ammonium-N. The vertical lines mark the time of hurricane disturbance.



Background
The final project is the reproduction of figure 3, from the article by Douglas A. Schafer titled, “Effects of hurricane disturbance on stream water concentrations and fluxes in eight tropical forest watersheds of the Luquillo Experimental Forest, Puerto Rico”. The final output is a plot with the chemical ions after the disturbance over a 9 week average from the years between 1985 to 1995.


Data
The data is from

library(tidyverse)
figure3 <- read_csv(
  "/Users/master/Downloads/Bren/MEDS Summer/eds214/MAH214final/output/clean_data.csv"
)



Methods
The first steps to reproducing the figure from Schaefer’s article was to sort through the raw data by cleaning it using select and filter functions. Sample_Date, Sample_ID, NH4-N, NO3-N, Ca, Mg, K and filtering through the correct time period which was from 1988 to the end of 1994.


Results

ggplot(
  data = figure3,
  mapping = aes(
    x = Sample_Date,
    y = concentration,
    linetype = site
  )
) +
  ggtitle(
    "Hurricane effect on stream chemistry"
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = ymd("1989-09-18"),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Years",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ion, ncol = 1, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # remove major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank() # remove minor grid lines
  )
